title: closed · From a STEP file to a mould you approve
excerpt: closed is a mould design studio. Upload a STEP file or a photo; the agent drafts the mould, stops at every decision that’s yours, and shows where every number came from. Join the waitlist.
content_html:
01Upload a STEP file or a photo.

Send the customer’s STEP file, or a photo of the part when that’s all you have. closed reads the geometry, keeps the customer’s part locked, and starts on the mould.

02The agent drafts every stage.

Parting, core and cavity, layout, mould base, feed, side actions and ejection. Each stage is logged with what it did and how long it took, so you can read the run like a build.

03It stops when the decision is yours.

Bore B1-3 runs 3.2 mm from an ejector pin, and your rule asks for 4.0 mm. closed doesn’t pick quietly. It sizes three fixes, recommends one, and waits.

Reject sits apart from Approve, on purpose.

04Every number shows where it came from.

Click any number to see its source and its working. A dimension in closed comes from one of six places, and the AI is never one of them.

Measured
by the CAD kernel, from the model

Your rule
from your shop’s rulebook

Catalogue
from your standard parts

Calculated
by the solver, with its working

Customer
from their drawing or datasheet

You
typed by you, and signed

05Take over any time, then hand back.

Agent and manual mode work on the same model. Change a value and the check updates as you type. Hand it back and the agent carries on from your edit.

The viewport rotates and pans like NX, SOLIDWORKS or Creo, whichever you’re used to.

06Nothing ships until you approve it.

Every stage ends with a list of what changed and who changed it. The customer’s part stays locked, and release waits for your sign-off.

Why I’m building closed.

Mould design still eats nights, and AI tools ask you to trust numbers you can’t check. closed works the other way round. It does the drafting, shows where every dimension came from, and changes nothing without you.

If you design moulds, I’d like to build this with you.

Follow @ironfisto on X

Download closed.

The studio runs on macOS and Windows, with apps for iOS and Android. Builds go to the waitlist first, so there’s nothing to download yet.
